basic_info.description: Rare opportunity to own and transform this mixed-use fixer-upper located in the prime Outer Sunset neighborhood! Nestled in one of San Francisco's most desirable areas, just minutes from the beach, Golden Gate Park, and vibrant local dining scenes.  This large-lot property offers incredible potential for investors, business owners, or those looking for a unique live-work space.  Previously home to a sushi restaurant on the ground floor and a spacious residential unit upstairs, the building has suffered a major fire damage and is now a blank canvas, ready for a visionary buyer to restore it to its full glory.  Bring your vision and creativity to this unique property and unlock its full potential! A rare chance to create something truly special in a fantastic neighborhood. Don't miss out!
